rules.formal: Every colour used is a palette colour.
rules.text: Always use the GOV.UK colour palette.
You must make sure that the contrast ratio of text and interactive elements in your service meets Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.2) success criterion 1.4.3 Contrast (minimum) level AA.

rules.formal: The focus colour #ffdd00 appears only on an element in its focus state.
rules.text: focus #ffdd00. Only use this colour to indicate which element is focused on. For example, when a user tabs to an element with their keyboard.
Success Criterion 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA): The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for the following:
Large Text: Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1;

rules.formal: Text in an inactive user interface component: no contrast requirement.
rules.text: Incidental: Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component, that are pure decoration, that are not visible to anyone, or that are part of a picture that contains significant other visual content, have no contrast requirement.

rules.formal: Text in a logo: no contrast requirement.
rules.text: Logotypes: Text that is part of a logo or brand name has no contrast requirement.

rules.formal: Large scale = at least 18 pt, or at least 14 pt and bold.
rules.text: large scale (text): with at least 18 point or 14 point bold or font size that would yield equivalent size for Chinese, Japanese and Korean (CJK) fonts
contrast ratio: (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L1 is the relative luminance of the lighter of the colors, and L2 is the relative luminance of the darker of the colors.

rules.formal: L = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B on linearised sRGB channels (threshold 0.04045, exponent 2.4).
rules.text: relative luminance: For the sRGB colorspace, the relative luminance of a color is defined as L = 0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B where R, G and B are defined as: if RsRGB <= 0.04045 then R = RsRGB/12.92 else R = ((RsRGB+0.055)/1.055) ^ 2.4 (and the same for G and B), with RsRGB = R8bit/255, GsRGB = G8bit/255, BsRGB = B8bit/255.

rules.formal: Points to CSS pixels at 4/3 px per pt: large = at least 24 px, or at least 18.67 px and bold. The normative text gives points only; the conversion comes from WCAG's non-normative Understanding page.
An element named as disabled or inactive is text in an inactive user interface component (D33); one named as a logo is a logotype (D34). Every other element in the questions is ordinary text.
